column1: # The hand picks over ../weapon-camo/weapon_camo.py's rule for the remodel-069 textures, a line a texture: its parts
# by a UV point on each, `+u,v` painted, `-u,v` bare; a texture with no points stays plain (its mask paints nothing).
# Made by the review of 2026-11-26 (../weapon-camo/README.md, "The review"): each texture's parts as 0.69d0's painted
# versions of it paint them (its _camo and premium textures, else its event skins), starting from whichever agreed
# better, the live mask's parts (weapon-modules@7, each texture's large parts) or the rule's; a texture with no
# painted version keeps the live mask's parts but where the rule is clearly right (a rod bare, large polymer or wood
# painted). A texture without a line takes the rule as it is.
